property_summary: The bank balance must increase by FEE_AMOUNT whenever a play() results in a win (pot reset to 0); the mutant fails because it pays the fee to the player instead.
change_summary: Replace 'payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' so the fee goes to the player instead of the bank.
